texas-instruments-25019707.text:
Change the world. Love your job.
The Smart Manufacturing and Automation team at Texas Instruments develops analytics solutions to address challenges faced by manufacturing and engineering teams. As a global organization, we strive to create solutions that are compatible with all TI sites. We're looking for candidates to join our team in Richardson, TX as we leverage modern technologies to deliver data, analytics and AI solutions that enhance quality and productivity in semiconductor manufacturing.
About the job:
Texas Instruments is looking for a Sr. AI/ML engineer who is experienced with developing and deploying multi-agent solution at scale. This role is critical to accelerating our digital transformation through rapid development of quality and test solutions using cutting-edge development techniques. The position offers the opportunity to revolutionize how our Smart Manufacturing and Automation team builds software while establishing best practices and scaling development capabilities across the organization.
We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with solid foundational expertise to develop and deploy intelligent solutions across our smart manufacturing platform. What sets this role apart: you'll leverage cutting-edge AI-assisted development platforms -Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and emerging agentic framework-to dramatically accelerate your development velocity while building production-grade ML systems. You'll collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to translate manufacturing challenges into scalable ML applications that directly impact manufacturing quality and test operations. This role emphasizes hands-on execution, rapid iteration, and learning: you'll build features that matter while growing your expertise in both ML engineering and AI-amplified development practices.
Key Responsibilities
Architect ML systems at scale — design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines combining structured and unstructured data; leverage LLMs, RAG, agents, and multi-agent systems to solve manufacturing problems; own data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, and deployment workflows
Lead GenAI innovation — architect LLM-based solutions including RAG systems, agentic workflows, and MCP integrations; experiment with prompt engineering and multi-step reasoning to extract actionable insights from manufacturing data
Bridge data infrastructure — design ML workflows that work reliably across our segregated database systems; understand trade-offs between different DB architectures and optimize data pipelines for both real-time and batch processing
Build and scale POCs — rapidly prototype solutions with cross-functional partners; translate business challenges into ML experiments; establish clear paths to productionize high-impact POCs with reliability, monitoring, and governance
Deploy and maintain systems — own full lifecycle deployment including DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure); establish monitoring, retraining pipelines, and drift detection; ensure models remain reliable in production
Lead the team — mentor junior ML engineers on best practices in ML engineering; conduct technical code reviews using Git/JIRA workflows; establish standards for reproducibility, testing, and documentation; drive agile sprint planning and technical discussions
Deploy and monitor models — participate in end-to-end deployment; own model monitoring, retraining pipelines, and performance tracking; troubleshoot production issues with senior engineers
Write quality code — develop production-ready code with testing and documentation; follow Git workflows, JIRA tracking, and agile practices; participate in code reviews and learn from feedback

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Graphics Technology, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field of study
5+ years of applied ML engineering experience — strong foundation in applied machine learning with proven impact in production systems
Generative AI & LLM engineering — hands-on experience building with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG systems, agents, and multi-agent orchestration; familiar with MCP (Model Context Protocol) patterns
Production ML engineering — proven ability to build, deploy, and maintain ML systems in production; experience with model versioning, monitoring, retraining, and drift detection

Preferred Qualifications:

Advanced AI/ML capabilities — experience building with LLMs or generative AI APIs; familiar with prompt engineering and AI workflow optimization
Semiconductor manufacturing expertise — familiarity with semiconductor fab operations, yield optimization, defect detection, process control, or equipment diagnostics
Advanced multi-agent systems — experience designing and optimizing multi-agent LLM systems; familiar with agent communication patterns and task decomposition
Leadership & mentorship track record — proven ability to grow junior engineers and establish technical standards; experience in cross-functional team environments

As part of the Data & Agentic Platforms and Solutions (DAPS) organization, this leader will be responsible for building and scaling a modern, reliable, secure, and reusable data ecosystem that powers business operations, advanced analytics, AI, and agentic solutions.
The role requires a hands-on technology leader who can drive enterprise-wide data engineering transformation, modernize legacy data integration patterns, and establish engineering practices that enable trusted, near-real-time access to data across product design , testing, manufacturing, supply chain, product engineering, customer, and enterprise functions.
The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership, execution discipline, and the ability to translate complex data challenges into measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
1. Enterprise Data Engineering Strategy & Architecture
Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy aligned with TI's business priorities and DAPS technology roadmap.
Architect scalable data integration, ingestion, transformation, and delivery capabilities across on-premises, factory, and cloud environments.
Drive modernization from traditional batch-oriented and point-to-point data movement toward event-driven, real-time, and reusable data architectures.
Establish standards for data pipelines, data contracts, data modeling, orchestration, and engineering practices.
Partner with enterprise architecture and platform engineering teams to drive adoption of open, interoperable data architectures.
2. Data Integration & Real-Time Engineering
Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale batch, streaming, and change data capture (CDC) pipelines.
Build robust data ingestion and integration capabilities using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, and modern data orchestration frameworks.
Enable near-real-time data availability for critical decision-making.
Drive reusable, metadata-driven integration patterns that reduce duplication and accelerate onboarding of new data sources.
Ensure data pipelines meet demanding requirements for throughput, latency, reliability, and recoverability.
3. Enterprise Data Products & Data Domains
Lead engineering delivery of trusted, reusable data products across domains.
Partner with domain owners, business teams, and data architects to establish authoritative sources and integrated data models.
Build standardized, governed data products accessible through APIs, events, and analytical interfaces.
Enable end-to-end data connectivity, traceability, and integration across business processes.
Establish engineering practices for data product lifecycle management, versioning, and service-level commitments.
4. Modern Data Platforms & Engineering
Drive adoption of modern lakehouse architectures, open table formats, and distributed data processing for on prem air gapped systems and multi cloud hybrid systems.
Engineer scalable data solutions using technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Spark, Trino, Databricks, and high-performance analytical databases.
Optimize data processing for performance, scalability, cost, and operational efficiency across hybrid environments.
Establish reusable frameworks for ingestion, transformation, data validation, and publishing.
Partner with platform teams to ensure consistent engineering practices across enterprise data infrastructure.
5. Data Quality, Reliability & Governance
Embed data quality, observability, lineage, and security into engineering workflows by design.
Establish automated data validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring.
Define and manage service-level objectives for data freshness, completeness, accuracy, and availability.
Partner with the Data & AI Governance Office to implement classification, access controls, retention, and compliance requirements.
Drive proactive incident prevention, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of data reliability.
6. AI-Ready Data & Knowledge Engineering
Enable trusted, contextualized, and accessible enterprise data for AI, machine learning, and agentic applications.
Build data engineering capabilities that support semantic layers, knowledge products, retrieval systems, and enterprise AI solutions.
Partner with AI engineering teams to ensure reliable data access through governed APIs, structured datasets, and knowledge interfaces.
Establish patterns for securely exposing enterprise data to agents while maintaining access controls, lineage, and accountability.
7. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of data engineers, technical leads, and engineering managers.
Establish strong engineering disciplines including CI/CD, DataOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and production observability.
Drive engineering productivity through standardization, automation, reusable components, and developer enablement.
Own delivery commitments, operational reliability, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform improvement within the data engineering function.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize investments based on measurable business impact.
Develop technical talent, succession plans, and a culture of ownership, accountability, and engineering excellence.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
15+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or enterprise data architecture, including significant experience leading large engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success designing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms in complex, global environments.
Deep expertise in distributed data processing, data integration, streaming architectures, and modern data engineering frameworks.
Deep expertise in deploying workload on Kubernetes environments
Strong experience with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Python, SQL, and modern data orchestration platforms.
Experience with lakehouse architectures, open table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, and distributed analytical systems.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, metadata management, governance, and security.
Proven ability to lead large-scale technology modernization and deliver reliable, production-grade engineering solutions.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills
